name: unity-runtime-invocation-table
target: Unity 2021 LTS – 6.x; runtime + editor C# scripting
status: DRAFT — orchestrator-authored skeleton from Unity domain knowledge. NOT yet validated. Every hostInvokedMethods list, attribute, and guard is a build target to VALIDATE/COMPLETE against the kb/gamedev/unity corpus + real-project probes before shipping. See plan doc §3 and AGENTS.md build lifecycle.

consumed.note: Sections here are read by unity.ts at runtime; the fields consumed are named per section. Everything under catalogNotes is documentation-only provenance. This mirrors blender-invocation-table.json's consumed/catalogNotes split.
consumed.detection: markers (any-of) used by detect() to recognize a Unity project
consumed.hostInvokedBases: key set (the host-invoked-base whitelist); <base>.hostInvokedMethods (engine/editor calls these by reflection, so they look dead)
consumed.serializationAttributes: attribute set → field kept live + its declared type emits a references edge
consumed.attributeEntryPoints: attribute → the decorated method/class is a host-invoked entry point (kept live); menu/path string captured where present
consumed.typeReferenceAttributes: attribute → typeof(X)/type argument emits a references edge to X
consumed.stringInvokedCallSites: callsite API → its string-literal method-name argument links to a sibling method (references)

sourcePriority: kb/gamedev/unity (to be built — Unity Scripting API + Manual mirror)
Unity MonoBehaviour message list (official Scripting API)

detection.note: detect() returns true when the C# project is a Unity project. Any-of; cheap markers first. TO VALIDATE.
markers: a file named ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt exists in the project
a .cs file contains `using UnityEngine;` or `using UnityEditor;`

hostInvokedBases.note: A class is host-invoked ONLY when its class-statement base is (structurally) one of these — mirrors Blender's registerableBases base-only rule. A magic-method name on a non-derived class is a normal method (falsePositiveGuards.no-magic-method-without-host-base). Method lists are CORE sets to VALIDATE/COMPLETE against the Unity Scripting API message index.

MonoBehaviour.detection: base list includes UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour (directly; cross-file base chains => emit nothing, see ceiling)

AssetPostprocessor.note: Some hooks are convention-named (OnPostprocess<Type>) and partially open-ended — VALIDATE the closed vs convention set.

serializationAttributes.note: A field bearing one of these is set by the engine/inspector via serialization — keep it live and emit a references edge to its declared type (a plain capitalized non-UnityEngine type name; skip builtins/primitives — false-positive-safe, mirror of Blender typeReferenceKwargs). TO VALIDATE.
resolverNotes: Public fields of a [Serializable]/MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject type are ALSO serialized with no attribute — detecting that requires the owning type context; treat as an extension, VALIDATE separately.
Skip primitive/builtin/UnityEngine.* field types (no fabricated ref).

attributeEntryPoints.note: The decorated method (or class) is invoked by the engine/editor/test-runner/network, not by any in-code caller — keep it live. Where a menu/asset path string is present, capture it. TO VALIDATE + COMPLETE (RPC/test attribute sets vary by package).

classAttributes.invokedBy: editor load runs the static constructor; keep the static ctor live

attributeEntryPoints.referenceKind: entry-point liveness (no target); pathArg strings captured for provenance, not link resolution in v1

typeReferenceAttributes.note: The attribute's typeof(X) argument emits a references edge to X — mirror of Blender typeReferenceKwargs. Skip UnityEngine.* / builtin types. TO VALIDATE.

stringInvokedCallSites.note: The string-literal method-name argument links to a sibling method (references) — the Unity analog of Blender's string-idname call sites. NON-LITERAL / computed args emit nothing. nameof(M) resolves to M. Overload ambiguity => link all overloads (mirror Blender). TO VALIDATE.

callSites.linksTo: method M on target (best-effort within project)
method M on the same class
coroutine method M on the same class
callSites.note: Generic StartCoroutine(M()) is a normal static call — do NOT special-case it here.

callSites.linksTo: method M on the declaring class
callSites.note: Mirror/UNet; VALIDATE against the networking package in use.

catalogNotes.note: Not read by unity.ts at runtime — provenance + guard record for behaviors hardcoded in the resolver (rule ids cited in comments). Mirrors blender-invocation-table.json catalogNotes.

baseWhitelist.description: The host-invoked-base whitelist. A UnityEngine/UnityEditor base NOT in this set does not make its methods host-invoked. Runtime equivalent: Object.keys(hostInvokedBases).

falsePositiveGuards.rule: A method named Update/Start/OnEnable/etc. on a class whose base is NOT in the whitelist is a NORMAL method — emit no host-invoked liveness. Enforced structurally: bases read only from the class-statement header.
class B : A where A's MonoBehaviour-ness is defined in another file => emit nothing for B's magic methods (the work-item-6 per-file-extraction ceiling; postExtract updateNode is update-by-id).
SendMessage/Invoke/StartCoroutine with a non-literal (variable/concatenated/interpolated) method-name arg emit nothing — never guess.
typeof(X)/SerializeField where X is a primitive/builtin/UnityEngine.* type emits no references edge (false-positive-safe).

Match attributes by resolved/using-qualified name where feasible; a user type coincidentally named e.g. `Test` must not trigger the NUnit rule. VALIDATE how strict this can be under regex-not-AST extraction.

dynamicOrOutOfScope.resolverBehavior: VALIDATE: optional string→type reference; low value, deprecated. Default emit nothing unless proven.
Generic type args are ordinary static type references — codegraph's C# extraction handles them; NOT a framework-resolver concern (do not double-emit).

tier2Deferred.description: Unity-only, asset-wiring — NOT in v1. Requires parsing non-code YAML assets, which no Blender analog needed.
items: UnityEvent inspector wiring: scene/.prefab/.asset YAML `m_PersistentCalls` (m_Target GUID + m_MethodName) → method. Needs .meta GUID↔script index + YAML parse.
Animation events: .anim asset `functionName` → method by name.
MonoBehaviour script-usage: scene/prefab `m_Script: {fileID, guid}` → the script asset (GUID from .meta).

resolverCoverageNotes: v1 (Tier 1) is code-only: base+magic-method liveness, serialization-attribute field liveness + type refs, attribute entry-point liveness, typeof type refs, and string-invoked sibling-method links.
Cross-file base chains, computed strings, reflection, and all Tier-2 asset wiring emit nothing (never guessed).
Every list/attribute set in this table is a DRAFT to validate against kb/gamedev/unity + real-project probes before ship.
